subject: general
question: Who among the following was a renowned dancer and the first person from Odisha to receive 'Padma Vibhushan' in 2000?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kelucharan Mohapatra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** was a legendary Indian classical dancer, guru, and proponent of the Odissi dance form.
 
• He was the first person from Odisha to receive the prestigious **Padma Vibhushan** award in the year **2000**.
 
• Kelucharan Mohapatra played a crucial role in reviving and popularizing Odissi dance globally.
 
• His contribution to Indian classical dance has been immense, earning him numerous accolades and recognition worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** was born on** 8th January 1926** in **Raghurajpur, Odisha**.
 
• He started his career as a Gotipua dancer and later transitioned to Odissi, under the guidance of various gurus.
 
• Kelucharan Mohapatra's work includes not only performances but also extensive teaching and choreography, ensuring the continuation and growth of the Odissi dance form.
 
• He established the **Srjan (Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Odissi Nrityabasa)** institution, which continues to train and promote young dancers in the Odissi tradition.
 
• His legacy is carried forward by his students, many of whom are celebrated Odissi dancers today.
